bull.t: Rapid revenue growth and contracted backlog
bull.b: The sharp revenue increase alongside a substantial contracted backlog indicates accelerating customer adoption and improving forward visibility. If deployments proceed as planned, the backlog can support recurring revenue growth over multiple years and provide a foundation for expanding the company’s infrastructure platform.

Longer contract durations and improving total-contract-value economics can make infrastructure investments more predictable and support stronger returns across the deployment cycle. These terms may also improve customer retention, revenue durability, and the company’s ability to fund continued capacity expansion.

Project-based financing and substantial customer prepayments reduce the amount of upfront corporate capital required to build new capacity. This structure can support backlog conversion while limiting dilution and aligning funding with contracted deployments, strengthening the growth model if execution remains on schedule.

bear.b: Large net losses show that the current revenue ramp has not yet translated into sustainable bottom-line profitability. Continued losses could consume financial resources, increase dependence on external funding, and make the company more vulnerable if deployments, pricing, or customer payments fall short of expectations.

High leverage reduces financial flexibility and leaves less capacity to absorb operating setbacks or fund additional expansion internally. It also increases refinancing and solvency risk if losses persist, particularly because the capital structure changed sharply from the prior year and debt remains substantial relative to equity.

bear.t: Rising lease obligations and infrastructure costs
bear.b: As the deployed GPU fleet expands, rising finance-lease principal payments create a recurring cash commitment that must be funded alongside operating expenses and new construction. This can constrain liquidity and reduce the benefit of reported cash generation, especially while profitability remains negative.
